# Theme 06 — Field Observer

**Working titles:** Observer Field · Frame Current · E = F·u

**Role:** Physics niche mode / later expansion.

---

## Fantasy

You are an observer choosing a velocity / frame `u`.
Field fragments `F` contract against you to yield measurable `E`-like pieces.
Merging fragments reorganises what an observer can measure.

Exact lesson when kept honest: contraction against an observer; not “all of Maxwell is this game.”

---

## Visual language

| Algebra | Look |
|---------|------|
| Observer blade | Camera / worldline marker |
| Field panel | Oriented plane / flux sheet |
| Contraction | Sheet pierced by observer → vector reading |
| Seam | Shared measurable factor |
| Scalar | Instrument reading / energy deposit |

---

## Strengths

- Ties to existing GA electrodynamics storytelling.
- Strong for a physics-curious audience.
- Good companion to the geometry atlas.

## Weaknesses

- Semantic “higher dimensions” story is harder to gameify than Fock occupation.
- Maxwell already has a large GA literature — novelty is packaging, not equations.
- Weaker cascade / factory dopamine than orbitals.

---

## Commercial use

- DLC / late campaign “field lab.”
- Cross-promo with physics education partners.
- Not the Steam storefront hero image.

---

## Decision notes

Keep as **expansion theme** after the foundry loop is proven fun.
